svg.title: Three patents, each a dated record of joined fields
svg.desc: Disclosure timeline for three US patents, simplified apparatus schematics with the fields each joined, and patent-citation lags for neglected papers.
svg.text: Three patents, each a dated record of fields joined and named by the inventors
A patent shows that a combination was disclosed on a date. It does not show commercial performance, later reliability, or that
nobody had seen the combination before filing.
Against four prior US patents that cured fluid deep in
the volume where beams intersected, Hull forms every
cross section at the surface with a single moving spot.
Forecast in the application: production costs similar to
injection molding for short runs. The grant does not test
raster scan, one cross section at a time
lasers, earlier used to coat machined parts
The beam is switched on only while its aim falls inside
the boundary of the current cross section, so only that
Establishes a disclosed design, nothing about the
Needles small enough to pass the outer layer of skin
without reaching the nerves; patterned directly using
States low unit cost in mass production; clinical efficacy,
economics and validity need separate evidence.
Neglected papers matched against a worldwide patent
database: how long until a patent first cited them.
slept ten years at a citation rate no higher than 0.5
no journal citations at all for five years
Years from publication to the first citing patent (filing year)
One paper on a switch chip, published in 1991 and uncited
by journals for five years, was first cited in a patent in 1993.
A patent citation shows a paper was noticed in a technical
setting, not that it had commercial value.
Sources: Hull, US 4,575,330; Deckard, US 4,863,538; Allen, Prausnitz, McAllister and Cros, US 6,334,856; van Raan and Winnink 2018,
Scientometrics 114. Apparatus drawings are simplified schematics after the patent descriptions, not reproductions of patent figures.
